title: Nalanda
subtitle: A site of learning and later scholarly memory in pilgrimage narratives
timeLabel: Sui–Tang pilgrimage and transregional knowledge networks
shortSummary: Nalanda places the pilgrimages of Xuanzang and Yijing within a concrete institution and transregional network rather than an abstract India.
curatorialDescription: The real map expresses a geographic referent; claims about scale, curriculum, participants and later sacred memory must be separated by source and period.
It is also a research-layer entry: traveller accounts, local traditions and modern archaeological narratives are not automatically equivalent.
researchNote: Travel records, archaeology, institutional history and cross-language comparison still need to be assembled.
